The list is bundled into the client, so the plugin works fully offli"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ne. 词库按 cet4/cet6 标签从 ECDICT 提取、按词频排序，内嵌进前端，运行时不需要网络。
- **Two study modes / 两种模式** — flip-card with "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"three-button grading (known / fuzzy / unknown), or multiple-choice quiz with distractors picked from"},{"id":"p6s5","text":" confusable words (edit distance, shared prefix/suffix/bigrams). 翻卡三键评分（认识/模糊/不认识），或形近词干扰项的选择题模式。
- "},{"id":"p6s6","text":"**Spaced repetition / 间隔复习** — Ebbinghaus-style ladder (10 min → 1 d → 2 d → 4 d → 8 d → 16 d); fail"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ed cards reset and re-queue after 10 minutes. 艾宾浩斯阶梯复习，答错 10 分钟后重新进队。
- **Daily plan / 每日计划** — conf"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"igurable daily new-word quota (0–500); today's review count shown on the pill badge. 每日新词数可自定义（0–500"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"），药丸徽标显示今日待复习数。
- **Review / extra practice / 复习与加练** — when today's quota is done, review due cards"},{"id":"p6s10","text":" (≤20) or practice 10 unseen words; practice results don't consume the quota. 完成当日额度后可复习到期词或加练未学词，不计"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"额度。
- **Auto-open / 思考时自动弹出** — opens the window automatically whenever a session starts running; to"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"ggleable in settings. 检测到会话运行时自动弹出窗口，可在设置中关闭。
- **Pronunciation / 发音** — real human US/UK recordings"},{"id":"p6s13","text":" fetched per word from Youdao's open dictionary audio (accent selectable: auto / US / UK), with the "},{"id":"p6s14","text":"browser's `speechSynthesis` as the offline fallback — no Windows voice pack or admin rights needed. "},{"id":"p6s15","text":"每个词实时取有道词典的真人美式/英式发音（口音可选：自动/美式/英式），断网时自动回落到系统语音合成——不需要安装任何 Windows 语音包，也不需要管理员权限。

| `scripts/build_client.mjs` | embeds `data/words.json` into `client.js` and synta"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"x-checks the result |
| `scripts/sync_locale.mjs [--check]` | keeps `locale/zh.json` + `locale/en.js"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"on` identical to the inline dictionaries in `client.src.js` |
| `scripts/smoke_release_install.mjs ["},{"id":"p18s5","text":"dir] [reference client.js]` | 56–57 structural checks: package fields, `shell.overlay` registration,"},{"id":"p18s6","text":" locale wiring, embedded word list |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Requirements: an authenticated `gh`, and an npm **granular access token with “Bypass 2FA” enabled** "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"(npm requires 2FA, or such a token, to publish) supplied via `--token-file` or `NPM_TOKEN_FILE`. Git"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"Hub traffic uses the proxy from `--proxy` (default `http://127.0.0.1:7897`); npm is deliberately cal"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"led without a proxy. The npm credential is written to a temporary userconfig and deleted afterwards "},{"id":"p19s5","text":"— `~/.npmrc` is never touched. 需要已登录的 `gh`，以及开启 Bypass 2FA 的 npm granular token；GitHub 走代理、npm 不走代理，"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"never touched. 需要已登录的 `gh`，以及开启 Bypass 2FA 的 npm granular token；GitHub 走代理、npm 不走代理，凭据只落在临时配置里且用完即删。"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Changelog / 更新记录"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### 0.2.6"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **双向边界适应 / Both-axis fitting** — 悬浮按钮与展开卡片现在横向、纵向都按当前视口钳制：大屏拖到边缘后缩小窗口、或拖到屏幕下方，按钮都会自动回到可见区域，不会消失；最小"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"化/展开时同样生效。Floating pieces are clamped on both axes, so shrinking the viewport (or dragging near the "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"bottom) never strands the button off screen.
- **贴边不留空、开关不消失 / No gap, toggle intact** — 右侧边界已计入朗读开关"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"位与边距，贴边时右边缘正好落在边界内侧；挤压态不再隐藏朗读开关。The right bound now accounts for the toggle slot and edge pad, and t"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"he reader toggle stays visible when squeezed.
- **拖动连续自适应 / Continuous reflow** — 宽度改由 CSS 变量驱动，拖动过程"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"中文字实时逐字压成一列，松手不跳变。Width is driven by a CSS variable, so the label reflows continuously while draggin"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"字实时逐字压成一列，松手不跳变。Width is driven by a CSS variable, so the label reflows continuously while dragging."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### 0.2.5"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **边界适应 / Edge-aware window** — 悬浮按钮拖到屏幕右侧后点开，卡片按 `384 × 缩放` 的真实视觉宽度自动内收，不再溢出右边界；不改动已保存的位置，收起后仍在原处；"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"DSH 侧栏或窗口尺寸变化时实时重算。The expanded card now fits itself inside the viewport by its real scaled width, w"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ithout moving the saved pill position, and re-fits on viewport resize.
